title: Thư chưa gửi
about: Round 15, mo-ao: G minor at 84 bpm in 3/4, one chord a bar, its tune low (C4-G5), C#dim7 and Am7b5 for the dark colour, a shimmer trembling above the tune in its middle and climax; an original tune; the left hand open (a deep bass, the chord broken an octave above it).
